The mechanism is likely mediated through the activation or inhibition of ATM, which is known to regulate cell survival and apoptosis. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for 17-Hydroxycryptotanshinone in modulating Mcl-1 expression, potentially through the activation of downstream signaling cascades. The evidence supports a functional link between the drug and Mcl-1, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
